scope: Bounded recheck of one outgoing and one incoming citation for three primary seed papers. Every edge below was observed in the citing paper itself. This is not an exhaustive cited-by census, a complete review, or a proof of novelty.
discovery: Previously recorded seed edges were re-opened and verified with the web tool on primary publisher/arXiv originals. No general search result was counted as an observed citation.
